三维气泡需要真实的正数 size，并注明大小指标与单位。: 3D bubbles require actual positive size values and the size metric and unit.
曲面需要完整且均匀的 X、Y 规则网格；缺失采样不能补零，也不能把散乱观测强行连: Surfaces require a complete, evenly spaced X/Y grid. Do not fill missing samples with zero or force a surface through scattered observations.
完整规则网格上的原始高度连接为三角曲面；可连续收为采样点，再展开回同一张曲面。: Original heights on a complete regular grid form a triangular surface, which contracts continuously into samples and unfolds into the same mesh.
保留真实 X、Y、Z，球体的正交投影面积与 size 成正比；可连续收为等大散点: Retain actual X, Y and Z. Orthographic sphere area is proportional to size and can morph continuously into equal-size points.
三角网格沿真实采样点连续收束与展开；位置、记录 ID 和输入高度保留，三维顶点逐: The triangular mesh contracts and unfolds along actual samples. Position, record IDs and input heights persist while world vertices update every frame.
同一对象在三维空间保留坐标，球体连续改变大小；投影面积使用实际 size，共用尺: Objects retain their 3D coordinates while sphere sizes change continuously. Projected area uses actual size on a shared scale.
同一张采样曲面收为三维原始点，再投影到 XY 平面；可反向展开，持续保留每条记录: Contract a sampled surface into its original 3D points, then project onto XY. Reverse the motion while retaining every record.
直接使用图库三维曲面的完整规则网格，value 对应 Z；不填补缺失采样。: Use the library surface grid directly, with value mapped to Z. Missing samples are not filled.
原有三维气泡收为等大散点，再转向 XZ 平面，球体位置和大小连续变化。: Shrink the existing 3D bubbles into equal-size points and turn toward XZ with continuous changes in position and size.
直接使用图库三维气泡的 X、Y、Z 与 size，投影面积与真实 size 成正: Use X, Y, Z and size from the library bubbles. Projected area is proportional to actual size.
完整网格的原始高度；相邻采样点之间线性连接: Original heights on a complete grid; adjacent samples are connected linearly
正交投影面积与真实 size 成正比；三个坐标保持原值: Orthographic area is proportional to actual size; all three coordinates retain their values
每行填写唯一对象名称、分组和三个真实坐标，并注明 X、Y、Z 的指标与单位。三维: Each row contains a unique object, group and three actual coordinates, with metric names and units for X, Y and Z. Bubbles also require positive size and axes.size; surfaces require a complete, evenly spaced X/Y grid. Projections hide one coordinate while preserving the original data and record IDs. Orthographic screen distances are not original spatial distances.
同一模型的得分阈值保持对应，横轴是已筛选样本占比，纵轴是已覆盖正类占比。同分样本: Threshold identities stay matched within each model. X is the selected fraction and Y is the fraction of positives captured. Tied scores enter together.
同一阈值点由累计增益转为提升倍数：正类覆盖比例除以筛选比例。未筛选样本时提升未定: The same thresholds move from cumulative gains to lift: the captured-positive fraction divided by the selected fraction. Lift is undefined at zero selection. Random selection has a baseline of 1.
提升 = 覆盖正类比例 ÷ 筛选比例 · 零筛选未定义: Lift = captured fraction / selected fraction · undefined at zero selection
同分整体进入 · 对角线为随机筛选基准: Ties enter together · diagonal = random selection
同一模型的同一得分阈值保持对应，在 ROC、PR、累计增益、提升和阈值轴间迁移；: Each model and score threshold stays matched while moving between ROC, PR, cumulative gains, lift and threshold coordinates. Axis meanings update with the view.
ROC 与 PR 的同一批阈值点连续移动到累计增益，再展开提升倍数，比较有限筛选: Move the same thresholds from ROC and PR to cumulative gains and lift, comparing positive coverage with a limited screening budget.
每行填写样本编号、模型、真实 0/1 标签和预测得分；不同模型评估同一批样本。同: Enter sample ID, model, actual 0/1 label and prediction score in each row. Models must evaluate the same samples. Ties enter together; lift is undefined at zero selection. All raw records are retained.
同一测试集 · 判别与筛选收益: Same test set · discrimination and screening yield
同一测试集 · 阈值点保持对应 · 同分整体进入: Same test set · matched thresholds · ties enter together
Sina 原始点收为嵌套尾部分位箱，再转向半眼密度与中央区间；每个样本持续保留。: Sina observations unfold into nested tail-quantile boxes, then turn into half-eye densities and central intervals. Every observation remains visible.
同一份 label/group/value 原始样本，共用带宽与数值轴；箱宽表示: One label/group/value sample table, sharing bandwidth and value domain. Box width encodes quantile depth; intervals are not confidence intervals for a mean.
单组原样本在密度抖动、尾部分位箱、半眼与等概率分位点阵之间连续展开，原值始终在场: One population continuously unfolds through Sina, tail-quantile boxes, half-eye and equal-mass quantile dots, retaining all raw observations.
单组实际样本；每个分位摘要点表示 2% 概率，独立于原样本身份。全部原始点另行保: One population of original measurements. Each quantile summary dot represents 2% probability with a separate identity; all original points remain visible.
幅相双面板合流为复平面，再转入增益相位轨迹；相同采样点及连线连续移动。: Magnitude and phase panels meet on the complex plane, then move to gain–phase coordinates. The same samples and links move continuously.
同一组原始正频率复响应，保留全部采样和单位；不拟合、不补负频率、不推断稳定性。: One set of original positive-frequency complex responses, preserving all samples and units. No fitting, negative-frequency synthesis or stability inference.
同一复响应 · 三种坐标表示: One complex response · Three coordinate views
原始点沿数值轴准确定位，横向范围由共用高斯带宽和密度尺度决定。横向抖动不是另一个: Original values retain their exact axis coordinate. A shared Gaussian bandwidth and density scale determine transverse jitter; jitter is not another measurement.
同一批原始点旁展开逐层尾部分位箱；箱宽表示分位层级，不表示频数密度。: Nested tail-quantile boxes unfold beside the same raw observations. Box width encodes quantile depth, not frequency density.
原始点转到横向数值轴，展开半侧密度、中位数及中央 50%/90% 样本分位区间；: Raw observations turn onto a horizontal value axis with a half-density, median and central 50%/90% sample-quantile intervals, not confidence intervals for a mean.
原始观测保留为下方点列，另外展开等概率摘要点。摘要点不是原样本，堆叠高度仅用于避: Raw observations remain in a separate lower strip while equal-mass quantile summaries unfold above them. Summary dots are not observations; stacking only avoids overlap.
同一组正频率复响应展开为对数频率下的幅值与相位两个面板。: The same positive-frequency complex responses unfold into magnitude and phase panels on a logarithmic frequency axis.
幅值与相位的同一采样点合流到复平面；只连接实际正频率输入，不补造镜像。: Two representations of each sample meet on the complex plane. Only supplied positive-frequency samples are connected; no mirror points are invented.
同一采样点移动到展开相位与分贝幅值坐标，保留采样顺序和曲线身份。: The same samples move to unwrapped-phase and decibel coordinates while preserving sampling order and curve identity.
数值轴保留原值；另一方向仅按密度抖动: The value axis retains original measurements; jitter on the other axis follows density
嵌套箱表示尾部分位区间，箱宽不是频数密度: Nested boxes show tail quantiles; box width is not frequency density
密度与中央 50%/90% 样本分位区间，不是均值置信区间: Density and central 50%/90% sample-quantile intervals, not mean confidence intervals
上方为等概率分位摘要，下方为全部原始观测: Equal-mass quantile summaries above; all original observations below
实心点与外环是同一采样的两种投影；只使用输入的正频率响应: Solid points and outer rings are two projections of the same sample; only supplied positive-frequency responses are used
同阈值：已筛选样本比例与已覆盖正类比例: Same threshold: fraction of samples selected versus fraction of positives captured
提升倍数 = 正类覆盖比例 / 筛选比例；零筛选时未定义: Lift = fraction of positives captured / fraction selected; undefined when none are selected
同一得分阈值展开为真实 0/1 类别的右连续经验累积分布，包含全部同分样本。最大: The same score thresholds unfold into right-continuous empirical CDFs for actual classes 0 and 1, including all tied observations. The maximum vertical distance D describes separation, not accuracy or significance.
实线：实际 1 · 浅线空心点：实际 0 · D 为描述性距离: Solid: actual 1 · pale open dots: actual 0 · descriptive distance D
右连续 CDF 包含同分样本；D 为最大类别内累计比例差，不是准确率: Right-continuous CDFs include ties; D is the maximum within-class cumulative-proportion gap, not accuracy
同一模型的同一得分阈值保持对应，在 ROC、PR、累计增益、提升、阈值轴和 KS: The same score thresholds of each model retain correspondence through ROC, PR, gains, lift, threshold response and KS CDFs. KS uses score ≤ t with all ties included; axes update with each view.
原值和目标保持不变；量程与区间只采用输入值: Original values and targets stay intact; ranges use supplied values only
各指标使用自己的单位和刻度，不跨单位比较长短: Each metric uses its own unit and scale; lengths are not comparable across units
同两条序列与真实时间间距；缺失处不连线或填充: The same two series retain actual time spacing; gaps are not connected or filled
横轴为拟合正态分位数，纵轴保留原值；不自动判定正态性: Fitted normal quantiles on x and original values on y; no automatic normality judgement
比较显式参考模型与右连续经验概率，不自动拟合参数: Compare an explicit reference model with right-continuous empirical probabilities; no automatic fitting
完整正寿命的 Weibull 概率坐标；未进行参数拟合: Weibull probability coordinates of complete positive lifetimes; no parameter fitting
阈值以上平均超额为派生摘要，短线保留全部原样本: Mean exceedances are derived summaries; the rug preserves all original observations
累计总试验时间份额，不是风险率: Cumulative total-time-on-test shares, not a hazard rate
等权样本和资源的累计份额；保留原值: Cumulative equal-weight population and resource shares; original values retained
DKW 同时置信带依赖独立同分布假设，不是均值区间: The DKW simultaneous band assumes IID observations; it is not a mean interval
Kaplan–Meier 持续比例；加号表示右删失: Kaplan–Meier survival; plus signs indicate right censoring
累积风险 Σd/n 不是概率，也不是 −log(S): Cumulative hazard Σd/n is neither probability nor −log(S)
圆面积表示非负原值；缺失与真实零分别标记: Circle area encodes nonnegative original values; missing and observed zero are distinct
仅颜色表示原值；扇区面积不表示数量: Only color encodes original values; sector area does not encode quantity
面积表示 |O−E|，带符号高度为 Pearson 残差；不输出显著性: Area encodes |O−E| and signed height encodes Pearson residuals; no significance claims
矩形面积表示联合频数；行内高度表示条件占比: Rectangle area encodes joint counts; within-row height encodes conditional shares
对角方块与边际比较一致性，完整表保留非对角计数: Diagonal squares and margins compare agreement; the full table retains off-diagonal counts
仅叶圆面积表示叶值，父圆是包络: Only leaf-circle areas encode leaf values; parent circles are enclosures
连线表示父子关系，角度与枝长仅用于布局: Links encode parenthood; angles and edge lengths serve layout only
父级是叶值汇总，父子合计不可重复相加: Parent totals summarize leaves; parent and child totals must not be added again
无向关系宽度表示权重；端点名称不表示方向: Undirected ribbon widths encode weights; endpoint names do not imply direction.
弧宽表示关系权重；弧高仅用于布局: Arc widths encode relationship weights; arc heights are layout only.
连线宽度表示权重，节点距离不代表数值差异: Link widths encode weights; distances between nodes are not numerical differences.
流带宽度表示原始流量；中间节点遵守输入的流量守恒: Ribbon widths encode original flow; intermediate nodes retain the supplied flow conservation.
箭头表示从来源到目标；保留每条有向边: Arrows point from source to target; each directed edge remains intact.
循环边和净流入保留；总边权不可当作去重总人数: Cycles and net inflows remain; total edge weight is not a count of unique people.
比较两组分位数，不将两个独立样本按行配对: Compares group quantiles without pairing independent observations by row.
纵轴为两组同概率分位数之差；派生点不是新增样本: The vertical axis is the difference at matching probabilities; derived points are not additional observations.
根号尺度比较观测与预期计数；预期值来自输入: Observed and expected counts on a square-root scale; expected counts are supplied.
保留原始观测与预期计数，不从图形自动拟合模型: Retains observed and expected counts without automatically fitting a model.
标准化残差减去理论正态分位数；不自动给出检验结论: Standardized residuals minus theoretical normal quantiles; no automatic test conclusion.
输入的标准化残差对照理论正态分位数: Supplied standardized residuals versus theoretical normal quantiles.
分组水平与离散度的对数关系；保留全部原始观测: Log relationship of group location and spread; all original observations remain.
展示原始分组观测及分布区间；不是均值置信区间: Shows original grouped observations and distribution intervals, not mean confidence intervals.
第二组 CDF 减第一组 CDF；并列值共同计入: Second-group CDF minus first-group CDF, including all tied values.
